fixer.title: Fix cloud customization sync feedback loop

introducer.title: agentHost: apply pending configuration before MCP startup

cases.mechanism: Identical active-client republications retried every failed customization, repeatedly re-reading/re-parsing plugin inputs and emitting protocol updates that fed further active-client publications.
cases.symptom: Cloud quick-chat startup could enter a persistent active-client/customization protocol loop; one reproduction produced 702 active-client and 355 customization-change records for a single turn and continued after completion.
cases.fixedBehavior: Structurally identical active-client snapshots now reuse the existing sync result instead of re-parsing failed plugins and republishing customization changes; retries remain bounded to explicit operation boundaries via force: true.
cases.evidence: Base line 9412 bypassed the identical-input no-op whenever any prior customization had Error status. Each republished SessionActiveClient assignment reaches CopilotActiveClientHandle.customizations (line 9733), which calls SessionPluginController.sync; sync then invokes pluginManager.syncCustomizations and emits customization state updates. The PR changes the no-op to apply to structurally identical inputs regardless of prior failure, while retryFailedClientSyncIfNeeded explicitly opts into force. The PR's reproduced scenario reports hundreds of active-client/customization records continuing after a turn, matching this call path.
